name: Communications
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of careful and godly communication, urging believers to guard their words and hearts so that their speech may be pleasing to the Lord. The Psalms call for divine protection over our mouths and lips, highlighting the need for self-control in what we say. Proverbs contrasts the harm caused by careless or excessive words with the wisdom and healing found in measured, knowledgeable speech, and it teaches that gentle answers can defuse anger while foolish talk only stirs strife. Together, these verses reveal that communication is a vital spiritual discipline that reflects the condition of the heart and impacts relationships.
